name: Aurora‑Stained Library Dome
description: A geodesic dome library where each triangular pane is stained glass depicting a different aurora display.
prompt: Interior of a massive geodesic dome library. The dome consists of hundreds of triangular stained‑glass panels, each illustrating a unique aurora borealis pattern in vivid greens, purples, reds. Sunlight streams through, casting shifting colored light on endless bookshelves. People reading quietly. Architectural photography style, ultra‑wide, high detail.
caption: Read beneath the dancing sky 📖🌌 #AuroraLibrary
